description: Answer a question about this codebase by traversing the semantic graph: what calls a function, what it calls, what a change to it would affect, and what a node is. No code is generated and no model is consulted — this is graph traversal, so it finds callers that grep cannot (and does not invent ones that do not exist). Prefer it over grepping for call sites.

question.description: e.g. "what calls resolve_calls?", "what would change if I edit tests_for?"

name: ask_codebase
title: Ask about call relationships
